description: Implement professional authentication service with Firebase Auth supporting Email, Google, and GitHub sign-in/signup, including user persistence and error handling with specific error messages.
steps: Create lib/services/auth_service.dart with methods: signInWithEmail(email, password) → Future<User?>, registerWithEmail(email, password, name) → Future<User?>, signInWithGoogle() → Future<User?>, signInWithGithub() → Future<User?>, signOut() → Future<void>, getCurrentUser() → User?, isAuthenticated getter. Use firebase_auth.User as internal representation. Catch Firebase Auth exceptions and convert to specific error messages: 'Invalid credentials', 'Email already in use', 'Weak password', 'Network error', etc. For GitHub OAuth: attempt using firebase_auth's GitHub provider if available; if not, stub with clear UnimplementedError message directing to SETUP.md. For Google, use google_sign_in package to get ID token, then sign in via Firebase. Return custom User model (from lib/data/models/user_model.dart) from all auth methods. On successful signup, store user document in Firestore at path 'users/{uid}' with fields: id, email, name, authProvider (google/github/email), createdAt, lastLogin. Handle auth state stream via authStateChanges() to persist login state across app restarts

Enhance lib/data/models/user_model.dart to add fields: profilePictureUrl (String?), authProvider (String: google/github/email), lastLogin (DateTime?). Add factory User.fromFirebaseUser(firebase_auth.User firebaseUser, String authProvider) that extracts id (uid), email, name, and constructs the User. Update toJson/fromJson to include new fields. Add a copyWith method for immutable updates

Create lib/core/providers/auth_provider.dart as ChangeNotifier wrapping AuthService. Expose: currentUser (User?), isAuthenticated (bool), isLoading (bool), errorMessage (String?). Constructor listens to Firebase Auth state stream and updates currentUser automatically. Methods: login(email, password), register(email, password, name), signInWithGoogle(), signInWithGithub(), logout(), clearError(). Each method sets isLoading=true, attempts auth operation, sets isLoading=false, and notifies listeners. On error, set errorMessage with specific error text and notify. Handle Firebase Auth exceptions: user-not-found, wrong-password, email-already-in-use, weak-password, network-request-failed, etc., mapping each to friendly user message

Update lib/main.dart: uncomment Firebase.initializeApp() call after Hive initialization. Add AuthProvider to MultiProvider before PesaTrackAIProvider (so auth is available when AI provider initializes). Import firebase_core and firebase_options. Update MultiProvider to: ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => ThemeProvider()), ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => AuthProvider()), ChangeNotifierProvider(create: (_) => PesaTrackAIProvider()). Note: PesaTrackAIProvider still needs hardcoded userId for now; that will be updated in FEAT-003

Update lib/screens/splash/splash_screen.dart to check authentication state. In initState, listen to AuthProvider.isAuthenticated (via context.read<AuthProvider>().currentUser != null). If user is authenticated, navigate to home route (/home). If not, navigate to login route (/login). Add a timeout (e.g., 3 seconds) so splash screen doesn't hang if auth state stream is slow. Use async/await and Firebase Auth's authStateChanges().first with timeout to wait for initial state check

Update pubspec.yaml to add dependencies: font_awesome_flutter: ^10.0.0 for social media icons, and conditionally flutter_appauth: ^8.0.0 only if GitHub OAuth is implemented via device flow (if using Firebase's GitHub provider directly, this may not be needed — confirm after researching Firebase GitHub sign-in). Run `flutter pub get` after changes
acceptance_criteria: AuthService class exists and implements all required methods with proper error handling
Firebase exceptions are caught and converted to specific, user-friendly error messages
User model includes new fields (profilePictureUrl, authProvider, lastLogin) and supports fromFirebaseUser factory
AuthProvider is a ChangeNotifier that reflects Firebase Auth state and exposes currentUser, isAuthenticated, isLoading, errorMessage
Firebase is initialized in main.dart and AuthProvider is registered in MultiProvider
SplashScreen checks auth state and routes to home or login based on isAuthenticated
Google sign-in works using google_sign_in + Firebase Auth integration
GitHub sign-in either works via Firebase's GitHub provider or is stubbed with clear instructions
Email signup/login works with form validation and specific error messages
Logout clears user state and navigates to login
pubspec.yaml is updated with new dependencies and flutter pub get succeeds
verification: Run `flutter pub get` to fetch new dependencies (font_awesome_flutter, conditionally flutter_appauth)
Run `flutter analyze` — no errors related to imports or lints
Manual test on emulator: launch app, verify SplashScreen loads and navigates to LoginScreen within 3 seconds
Manual test email signup: fill form, click Create Account, verify user is created and persisted in Firestore at users/{uid}
Manual test email login: log out, enter credentials, verify login works and navigates to home
Manual test Google sign-in: tap Google button, verify OAuth flow completes and user is created/logged in
Manual test GitHub sign-in: tap GitHub button, verify OAuth flow or clear error message appears if not configured
Manual test logout: navigate to settings/profile, tap logout, verify navigation to login and user state cleared
Verify Firebase Console: enable Email/Password, Google, and GitHub sign-in providers (manual step for developer)
Commit changes locally with message 'feat: add professional multi-auth with Email/Google/GitHub'
findings: Note: firebase_options.dart must be generated by running `flutterfire configure` with a real Firebase project. This file is NOT present in the repo and should NOT be manually created. The developer must set up a Firebase project in Firebase Console, then run flutterfire configure locally to generate firebase_options.dart. OAuth2 credentials for Google and GitHub must be configured in Firebase Console before testing sign-in flows. This is a manual prerequisite and should be documented.
